content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To make a corn salsa, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Finely dice the red onions (10 minutes)
Step 2. Husk the fresh ears of corn (5 minutes)
Step 3. Scrub the corn silk off the cobs (3 minutes)
Step 4. Toss the mixture with sea salt (1 minute)
Step 5. Light the outdoor charcoal grill (20 minutes)
Step 6. Garnish with fresh cilantro sprigs (2 minutes)
Step 7. Buy a bag of natural lump charcoal (30 minutes)
Step 8. Brush the corn with melted butter (4 minutes)
Step 9. Juice three large limes (3 minutes)
Step 10. Zest the lime skins (5 minutes)
Step 11. Core and seed the jalapeños (6 minutes)
Step 12. Grill the corn until charred (15 minutes)
Step 13. Wash the tomatoes and peppers (4 minutes)
Step 14. Cut the kernels off the grilled cobs (8 minutes)
Step 15. Soak the diced onions in cold water to mellow (15 minutes)
Step 16. Fold in the fresh chopped cilantro (2 minutes)
Step 17. Sanitize the kitchen counter and cutting boards (10 minutes)
Step 18. Mince the garlic cloves (5 minutes)
Step 19. Boil a small pot of water (8 minutes)
Step 20. Slice the cherry tomatoes in halves (7 minutes)
Step 21. Find the sharp chef's knife in the drawer (1 minute)
Step 22. Peel the papery skin off the garlic (2 minutes)
Step 23. Combine corn kernels and onions in a large bowl (3 minutes)
Step 24. Clean the grill grates with a wire brush (5 minutes)
Step 25. Measure out the cumin and chili powder (2 minutes)
Step 26. Sharpen the chef's knife with a whetstone (10 minutes)
Step 27. Finely chop the bell peppers (12 minutes)
Step 28. Dice the jalapeño peppers (8 minutes)
Step 29. Mix the garlic into the chopped peppers (2 minutes)
Step 30. Place the serving bowl on the table (1 minute)
Step 31. Drain any excess liquid from the peppers (2 minutes)
Step 32. Whisk the lime juice and olive oil (3 minutes)
Step 33. Pull the husks back to use as handles (2 minutes)
Step 34. Rinse the fresh produce under the tap (5 minutes)
Step 35. Sprinkle the corn with cracked black pepper (1 minute)
Step 36. Prepare a side of tortilla chips (2 minutes)
Step 37. Wipe down the vegetable chopping station (5 minutes)
Step 38. Blanch the jalapeños briefly (2 minutes)
Step 39. Lay the corn on the hot grill (1 minute)
Step 40. Retrieve the vegetables from the refrigerator (2 minutes)
Step 41. Add a pinch of sugar to the spice mix (30 seconds)
Step 42. Lightly oil the grill grates (2 minutes)
Step 43. Pat the peppers dry with a paper towel (2 minutes)
Step 44. Pour the lime juice over the vegetables (1 minute)
Step 45. Combine all chopped ingredients in the main bowl (5 minutes)
Step 46. Take the spices out of the pantry (2 minutes)
Step 47. Remove the jalapeño veins for less heat (4 minutes)
Step 48. Dice the poblano peppers (7 minutes)
Step 49. Chop a bunch of fresh cilantro (5 minutes)
Step 50. Inventory the spice rack (10 minutes)
